settings.heading: What is your Initial Necklace made of?
settings.row_content: Our Dainty Heart Initial Necklace is crafted from lightweight alloy, featuring a delicate heart charm and your chosen initial. Available in Gold and Silver finishes, it's a sweet, minimalist accessory for everyday styling.

settings.heading: Can I choose my own initial and color?
settings.row_content: Absolutely! Choose any letter from A–Z and your favorite Gold or Silver finish. Whether it's your own initial or someone special's, each necklace adds a personal little touch to your look.

settings.heading: How will my necklace be shipped?
settings.row_content: Your necklace will be prepared according to your selected initial and color. We recommend checking your order confirmation and tracking details for delivery updates. Shipping times depend on your destination.

settings.heading: What if my necklace arrives damaged?
settings.row_content: If your necklace arrives damaged, please contact our support team with photos of the item and packaging. We'll review the issue and help arrange an eligible replacement or refund according to our return policy.

settings.text:
Some letters mean more than others. Our dainty necklace pairs a tiny heart with the initial that means the most to you.

Choose your favorite letter from A–Z, in Gold or Silver, for a delicate everyday touch or a sweet, meaningful gift for someone special.
